parent_objective: audit executable workload materialization before full rollout execution
blocked_by: need materialization audit before 864-cell rollout execution
supersedes: direct full rollout execution after M1690

public_gates: M1691 must audit M1690 artifacts before rollout execution
M1690 must have 72 executable specs and 864 workload cells
M1690 must have zero contract and guardrail violations
M1691 must not run rollout train replay PPO promote use private holdout or change actor inputs
M1691 must not claim controller-family ranking paper-level evidence or level3 self-ID

workflow_synthesis.evidence_increment: audits executable workload materialization before full rollout execution
workflow_synthesis.claim_scope: process audit only; no rollout, training, replay, PPO, promotion, private holdout, controller ranking, paper-level or level3 claim
stop_condition: stop if materialization artifacts are incomplete
stop if any contract or guardrail violation exists
stop if proxy-template mapping is not documented
stop if audit would route directly to ranking claims
fallback_plan: route to materialization repair if audit fails
route to full rollout execution design if audit passes
workflow_synthesis.synthesis_trigger: M1690 produced no-rollout executable materialization artifacts

admission_evidence: M1690 reports 72 executable specs, 864 workload cells, and zero contract/guardrail violations
blocked_shortcuts: do not claim controller ranking or level3 self-identification
allowed_updates: M1691 status queue scoreboard research log and review
one follow-up execution-design or repair manifest
next_stage_criteria: proxy-template and contract checks are audited

self_id_evidence_discipline.current_frame_substitution_risk: high; M1691 audits workload materialization only.
history_necessity_tests: audit must ensure L1, L2-current-tiled, and L3-reset controls remain in the workload
self_id_evidence_discipline.negative_result_policy: If audit fails, route to materialization repair without rollout.
allowed_claims: no rollout, no training, no replay, no PPO, no private-holdout, no promotion, no paper-level result or level3 self-identification claim

hypothesis: M1690 materialization artifacts are complete enough to admit a separately designed 864-cell public rollout execution.
success_criteria: M1690 summary and materialization artifacts are readable
audit preserves no-ranking no-paper no-level3 claim boundary
failure_criteria: M1690 counts or contract checks fail
audit claims controller-family ranking or level3 self-ID
environment rollout training replay PPO private holdout promotion or actor-input changes occur

commands.name: audit
commands.command: audit M1690 materialization artifacts and decide execution-design or repair route

decision_rule: M1691 passes if it audits M1690 materialization as complete clean no-rollout evidence and routes explicitly to rollout execution design or repair.
